verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a v2 REST API at rest.ripplingapis.com with clear authentication: Bearer API tokens whose scopes intersect with the owner's permissions, plus OAuth 2.0 for partner apps. The docs also cover cursor/limit pagination, filtering, dated versioning, an npm SDK and a first authenticated call example. However, the evidence never shows endpoints for the directory objects the story names (users, groups, app assignments); the only resource cited is 'List companies', and group/access management appears only as UI automation claims. Missing for 10: documented user, group and app-assignment endpoints, evidence that filtering applies to directory resources, independent or hands-on corroboration.
